identitySignals: Agenda names 'Lead by Learning (Northeastern University, formerly Mills College)'; Lead by Learning's own site says it became a Center of Mills College at Northeastern University in 2024-25 and grew out of Mills Teacher Scholars
Based at 5000 MacArthur Boulevard, Oakland, CA, in the OUSD service area; Northeastern's Oakland campus directory lists Lead by Learning there

Lead by Learning provides professional development and coaching for teachers and school leaders, consistent with OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contract and a school-site (Coliseum College Preparatory Academy) improvement plan budget
Legal entity: Northeastern University is a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN shown)
research.notes: Lead by Learning is a program/center of Northeastern University (previously Mills College), not a separate legal entity; legal name and EIN are those of Northeastern University (Boston, MA). Mills College's own EIN and California entity number were not researched. No page found explicitly mentions OUSD; identity rests on the agenda's own name and the Oakland-based education work.

profile.summary: Lead by Learning is a center of Mills College at Northeastern University in Oakland, California. It works with teachers, school leaders and school districts on professional development, using teams that study their own classroom practice together to improve learning for students. It began as Mills Teacher Scholars at Mills College.

review.notes: The agenda names Lead by Learning (Northeastern University, formerly Mills College), and the cited pages confirm it is an Oakland center of Mills College at Northeastern doing educator professional development.
